items.name: Cloak of the Cliff Beacon
items.lore: Sea-grey, with a Hibernian knot in beacon-red. Given to those who burned the longphort.

items.name: Raven-Shield Torc
items.lore: Bronze, cut from the rim of a Norse shield. The raven's been filed off.

items.name: Watch-Ring of Moher
items.lore: The Watch's ring: the tower, the beacon and the sea.

items.name: Shingle-Runner's Bracer
items.lore: Hard leather, scuffed from running across wet stones under arrows.

items.name: Jarl Hrafn's Raven Shield-Boss
items.lore: The iron boss of Jarl Hrafn's shield. Still dented where it stopped your blade.

draughts: Brewed in Tir Urphost and carried down the cliff. Salty.
Clears the head of fog. Most of it.
Don't ask what's in it. It keeps you going all night, like the beacon.
For when the longships come out of the fog right on top of you.
Heather mead from the plateau. Everything comes back a little faster after a cup.
